name: cep-input
description: Input field for Brazilian postal code (CEP) with automatic address lookup via ViaCEP API

behavior.autoFetch: When autoFetch=true and CEP is valid, fetches address from ViaCEP API automatically

states.name: not_found
states.description: Valid format but CEP does not exist

context.whenToUse: When collecting a Brazilian address — CEP auto-fills street, neighborhood, city and state
context.whenNotToUse: For international addresses or when you already have the full address
context.accessibility: Announces loading state and address result to screen readers
context.culturalNote: CEP (Código de Endereçamento Postal) is Brazil's 8-digit postal code. Entering it auto-fills the rest of the address via ViaCEP, a free public API. This is standard UX in Brazilian e-commerce.
